title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: enabling a second holder of an overlay name takes back the package-less row the read-side hydrator laid into the first holder's registry slot while the second was disabled (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDUKRjQSg19phJJRHRL22WQ)_
Fixes #32820

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no registry read of a holder's item after a disable and enable; the prescription ships in the ADR-0087 entry and the changeset's FROM → TO.

> **BREAKING** (narrowing, `minor` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, ADR-0087 entry `package-less-overlay-row-holder-slot-on-reenable` registered): after a second holder of an overlay name is enabled again, a holder's registry item, its scoped list and its registry list stop answering the environment's package-less row as the holder's own.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个包 A、B 都持有同名的可覆盖条目（email_template、dashboard、report），环境里还有一条不带包的同名行。B 停用期间做一次不带包的列表读，读侧回填会把这条环境行按 A 的外壳放进 A 的槽位（这时 A 是唯一被服务的持有者，按 ADR-0150 D4 是对的）；但 B 重新启用后没人把它收回，A 的 registry 槽位、带 A 的列表和执行列表一直把环境行当成 A 自己的答出来。现在启用 B 时立刻按当下两个持有者重建这条，A、B 各自答自己的条目。
- 为什么改：专题 #31527 红线 2（歧义要报、不能猜成某个持有者的）；发送时读取、带包列表、执行列表直接读 registry，会用错正文。
- 风险与回滚：窄化（Clause-② no (narrowing)，Metadata-protocol narrowed）：仓内第一方组合没有两个包持有同名可覆盖条目加不带包行的情形，答案不变。只动内存 registry 槽位，不改任何键、值或存储形状；精确读（`?package=`）本来就 409 列出两者，不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`（`recordSoleHolderEnvelope`、`healSoleHolderEnvelopes`、`hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` 里注册后的记录点）；`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` 的 `[#32820]` 段；`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-less-overlay-row-holder-slot-on-reenable.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32820`，预期 9 个全部通过（三种类型 × 两种注册顺序，外加三条对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

While one of two holders of an overlay name is disabled, the other is the one served holder (#32183), so a package-less `sys_metadata` row of the name is its customization: the read-side hydrator (an unscoped list read, the boot load) lays the row into that holder's registry slot under its artifact envelope. Enabling the disabled holder ran no hydration, so until the next unscoped list read the holder's `getPackageScopedItem(type, name, holder)` (what a send-time read takes), its scoped list (`GET /meta/:type?package=HOLDER`) and the registry list scoped to it answered the environment's row as the holder's own (the registry list carried both).

All in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`:

- `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` records, per registry, each entry it registers for a package-less row under a sole holder's envelope (host, type, name, bundle member, row data, holder, and the registered object). Any other registration of the same key forgets the record.
- The first record for a registry subscribes `healSoleHolderEnvelopes` to the registry's existing `onPackageEnabled` notice. On an enable it rebuilds each recorded entry exactly as the hydrator would build it for the holders served then (`soleHolderOf`): with two served, no holder's envelope, so each holder's slot answers its own item again. Synchronous inside the enable, so every enable door (`PATCH /packages/:id/enable`, an install's `enableOnInstall`) answers after it.
- Identity guard: an entry the slot no longer holds as registered (a later write, delete or hydration replaced it) belongs to that write and is left alone; its record is dropped.

Merged with `main` once (`bf02d33b`), which brought #33126's edit of the same file (the flow-slot gate judged against every shipper). The two touch different branches of `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` (that gate returns before registration; the record sits after it), merged without conflict, and every pin below was re-run and re-ablated on the merged head.

The ADR-0087 entry's remedy and the changeset's FROM → TO were re-read against the remedy order that landed for #32968 (`152b53c77`) and now say the same: keep the package-less row's stored body and clear any row of the name bound to a package first, then delete the package-less row, then save the declared override in the holder's `.custom` pair.

### FROM → TO

| case (two holders A and B of an overlay name, a package-less row stored) | FROM (`main`) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| B disabled, unscoped list read, B enabled: A's `getPackageScopedItem` | the environment's row, stamped A | A's own item |
| same: list scoped to A (`GET /meta/:type?package=A`) | the environment's row | A's own item |
| same: registry list scoped to A | A's own item and the environment's row | A's own item |
| same: B's three readers | B's own item | B's own item (unchanged) |
| protocol exact read `?package=A` | `409 ambiguous-in-closure` naming both | unchanged |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: the healed slot equals the one the hydrator builds with both holders served; an enable that still leaves A the one served holder keeps the row as A's customization; an entry written over the slot after the hydration is untouched by the enable.

### Carried, not here (findings, not widened)

- A holder **installed** (not re-enabled) after the hydration that ships the name: the slot keeps the row until the next unscoped hydration, as before. No registry notice reaches the protocol for a new holder; the fix needs `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, outside this card's file surface. Stated in the changeset's "Not changed".
- The remedy order: the package-less row must be deleted before the holder's `.custom` override is saved (run after, the same delete removes the override), and a save at `?package=HOLDER` on a code package answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming its pair. Both are written into the ADR-0087 entry.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, `[#32820]` describe (9): `email_template`, `dashboard`, `report` × both registration orders: B disabled, unscoped list read (A's slot reads the env row), B enabled: A's slot, stamp, scoped list and execution list answer A's own; B's answer B's own; the exact read still 409 `ambiguous-in-closure`. Three CONTROLs as above. The `[#32568]` comment that named this gap now points here.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` and `protocol.register-item-call-sites.test.ts`: the call-site censuses record the heal's artifact lookup and registration.

The objectql suite imports `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through its `exports` (built `dist/`, no vitest alias), so each leg was rebuilt and the marker proved present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` before reading.

- **Heal**: the enable listener made a no-op (`registry.onPackageEnabled(() => console.debug('ABLATION32820-HEAL', ...))`). `[#32820]`: 7 failed, 2 passed: all six type × order pins and the "slot after the heal" CONTROL; the two other CONTROLs (one served holder kept; later write untouched) stay green, as they should. Quote: `AssertionError: B enabled: expected { slot: 'env row', …(3) } to deeply equal { slot: 'alpha own', …(3) }`.
- **Identity guard**: `registry.getItem(...) !== record.registered` replaced by a marker that is never true. `[#32820]`: 1 failed, 8 passed: exactly the "entry written over the slot after the hydration" CONTROL. Quote: `AssertionError: expected { name: 'welcome', …(5) } to be { name: 'welcome', …(5) } // Object.is equality`.
- Restore legs: `ok restored: blob == HEAD (aa4ea15ed590) and git diff HEAD is empty`; rebuild exit 0; `marker absent from all 24 built files`; `working tree clean against HEAD`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Epic red lines: (1) resolution is not loosened: the exact read is unchanged and nothing refused is now served; (2) the ambiguity is no longer guessed into a holder's slot; (3) independently releasable: no key, column, URL or stored shape moves, the phase-1 one-holder tests in the same suite stay green, and bare-name behaviour is unchanged.
- No new export: the heal is module-internal.
